foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: A foreign physician must hold a standard certificate from the Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates or pass an examination satisfactory to the state board for medicine. Alternatively, a US resident enrolled in a foreign medical school recognized by the WHO may qualify by completing formal requirements, passing a qualifying examination acceptable to the state board, completing one academic year of supervised clinical training, completing required postgraduate hospital training, and passing the licensing examination.
